segments.text: How are you feeling, Little Bear? My mom still hurt.
Oh, I have some ice cream. Ice cream is good for bears with the mumps.
I wish I wasn't sick, Mother Bear. I want to play with my friends.
I know. Why don't you shut your eyes? And that will help you feel better.
Oh, Mother Bear! Someone is at the door!
Hello, Lucy. How do you feel?
I have the mumps. I know. Do they hurt?
Little. I have a present for you, Little Bear.
Something to cheer you up. It's a book I wrote.
Oh, wait, I forgot. I better stay out here. Or I might catch the mumps too.
What's the book called? It's called Between Friends.
Will you read it to me? Oh, but you're over there. And I'm over here. That's okay. I know what all by heart.
Hey, H1. I hope this book makes you feel better by remembering the times we shared together.
Do you remember the first time we met?
I do. And I like the picture you drew, Emily.
I flew down the tree. Are you all right?
Are we still going the right way?
Turn the page now, Little Bear.
There was a time Emily met Owl, Hen, and Cat. And Ducks Nises and nephews needed to be babysat.
Oh, my mom's hurt when I laugh.
One day Owl had a party.
Then Lucy fell down the tree.
And what a good doctor Little Bear turned out to be.
Good. I hope it makes you feel better.
Look at what Emily brought me. She made it herself.
But I think you should go home now. I don't want you catching the mumps.
Thank you for the book, Emily.
I have a present for you.
Don't worry. You've already had the mumps.
Granny says you can't catch them again.
It's the book I made for you.
Is that you and me at Hopfrog pond?
You draw very well, Little Bear.
Mother Bear helped rate the story for me, but I told her what's right.
Emily is Little Bear's best friend.
He hopes she gets better soon.
Let's go to Hopfrog pond again.
There's still one more page left.
I thought we should write something together.
How about this story really has no end?
Because this story is between friends.
I did the words so you can do the picture.
Now the book really belongs to both of us.
